dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.subtitle: Legal and technical transparency regarding information processing.
dataUsage.lgpdRolesP1Start: Campo Branco acts exclusively as a
dataUsage.lgpdRolesP1End: , under Art. 5, VII of the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13.709/2018 – LGPD).
dataUsage.lgpdRolesP2End: is the local congregation using the platform, through its responsible representatives (elders and appointed servants), who define the purposes, use, maintenance, and deletion of the information.
dataUsage.lgpdRolesP3: Campo Branco does not define purposes, does not decide on the content entered, and does not use the data for its own purposes.
dataUsage.securityDesc: Appropriate technical and organizational measures are adopted, compatible with the state of the art and the risks involved, in accordance with Art. 46 of the LGPD, aiming to protect personal data against unauthorized access, leaks, loss, or misuse.
dataUsage.s1Title: 1. Legal Basis and Purpose of Processing
dataUsage.s1Lead: Personal data processing is based on:
dataUsage.s1LegalRef: in accordance with Arts. 7, IX, and 11, II, “f”, of the LGPD.
dataUsage.s1Purpose: The purpose of processing is strictly organizational and pastoral, aiming to support the efficiency of volunteer work and the respectful conduct of religious activities, without any commercial, advertising, or economic bias.
dataUsage.s2AResidentItem3: Gender (used only to guide a respectful approach)
dataUsage.s2AUserItem2: Minimum technical logs for control, auditing, and security
dataUsage.s2BDesc: The system does not require registration of sensitive data. Any tags (e.g., “Deaf”, “Sign Language”) are:
dataUsage.s2BItem1Desc: entered manually at the user's discretion
dataUsage.s2BItem2Desc: used only when strictly necessary for accessibility
dataUsage.s2BItem3Desc: handled under religious and pastoral confidentiality
dataUsage.s3P1: Any tag related to minors does not imply active collection of personal data of the child, nor creation of profiles or profiling practices.
dataUsage.s3P2: These tags function exclusively as responsible conduct alerts for volunteers (e.g., avoiding direct approach to unaccompanied minors), observing the best interest of the child and adolescent, in accordance with Art. 14 of the LGPD.
dataUsage.s4Lead: It is essential to distinguish the software from the processed data:
dataUsage.s4Item1: Campo Branco's source code is open source, licensed under the MIT License.
dataUsage.s4Item2: The open-source nature does not extend to:
dataUsage.s4Note: These elements are private, closed, and protected.
dataUsage.s4Fork: Any copy, fork, or self-hosting of the software must operate with a completely independent database, without any access to or integration with the official database.
dataUsage.s5Item1Desc: one congregation's data is inaccessible to others.
dataUsage.s5Item2Desc: defining retention periods and permanent deletion of data are the sole responsibility of the controller (local congregation).
dataUsage.s5Note: Deletion is performed manually by authorized users, according to pastoral and organizational needs.
dataUsage.s6P1: The platform provides tools for editing and deleting data.
dataUsage.s6P2: However, formal requests related to data subject rights (access, correction, deletion, etc.) must be directed to the responsible local congregation, as the controller of the specific data.
dataUsage.nonCommercialLead: We reaffirm our commitment to privacy:
dataUsage.nonCommercialItem1: Campo Branco does not sell, rent, monetize, or share personal data.
dataUsage.nonCommercialItem2: The platform is 100% free of advertising, commercial trackers, or economic exploitation of information.

userCommitment.title: User Commitment and LGPD
userCommitment.subtitle: Your responsibilities when managing third-party data.
userCommitment.introStart: By using Campo Branco to store territory information, you act as a
userCommitment.introEnd: (or processor under the guidance of a controller), as defined by the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD - Law No. 13.709/2018).
userCommitment.cardLead: When registering addresses, resident names, or special notes (such as "Deaf" or "Foreign Language"), you declare and commit to:
userCommitment.item1Desc: Use the data exclusively for religious and pastoral organization purposes, without diversion to commercial, political, or personal objectives.
userCommitment.item2Desc: Record only the data strictly necessary for the visit, avoiding excessive, subjective comments or anything that could embarrass the data subject.
userCommitment.item3Desc: Keep your credentials and territory access links restricted to assigned individuals only; do not share them in public groups or on the internet.
userCommitment.notesDesc: The system allows recording observations about visits (e.g., "Not at home", "Asked to return"). It is the user's responsibility to ensure these notes are respectful and factual.
userCommitment.deletionDesc: If a resident requests that their data not be used or be deleted, the administrator user must immediately remove that information from the system.
userCommitment.disclaimer: Disclaimer: Campo Branco provides the technological platform, but does not directly manage or control the data entered by local congregations. Compliance with the LGPD during field activities is the sole responsibility of users and their respective congregations.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro1Start: Your privacy is a priority. This Privacy Policy explains, clearly and transparently, how
privacy.intro1End: collects, uses, stores, and protects personal data, in accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13.709/2018 – LGPD).
privacy.intro2: {appName} is a digital tool intended to support the religious, pastoral, and organizational activities carried out by congregations of Jehovah's Witnesses and their members.
privacy.intro3: The application is not operated, administered, maintained, nor officially endorsed by the religious organization of Jehovah's Witnesses. Its use occurs independently, under the responsibility of local congregations and the users who operate it.
privacy.s1ControllerDesc: The local congregation using the application and/or the administrator users designated by it, responsible for registering, defining purpose, maintaining, accessing, and deleting information entered into the system.
privacy.s1OrgNote: The religious organization of Jehovah's Witnesses, at an institutional level, does not act as controller, does not define processing purposes, and has no direct access to the data stored in the application.
privacy.s1ProcessorDesc: {appName}, which provides the technological platform and processes personal data exclusively according to the controller's instructions.
privacy.s1ProcessorNote: {appName} does not decide the purpose of data usage, limiting itself to providing the technical means for internal organization and use.
privacy.s2Intro: In strict observance of the Principle of Necessity and Data Minimization (Art. 6, III of the LGPD), the system does not register residents by name, does not perform gender profiling, and does not collect sensitive personal health data or data of minors.
privacy.s2_1Title: 2.1. Territorial and Logistical Data (Non-Personal Resident Data)
privacy.s2_1Item1: Public address (street, number, and territorial reference)
privacy.s2_1Item3: Building access notes (e.g., doorbell, gate, dog in yard)
privacy.s3Title: 3. PURPOSE AND LEGAL BASIS OF PROCESSING
privacy.s3Lead1: Data processing is restricted to the following legal bases provided in the LGPD:
privacy.s3LegalItem1: Legitimate interest (Art. 7, IX) for territorial and logistical planning
privacy.s3LegalItem2: Regular exercise of internal pastoral and religious activity
privacy.s3LegalItem3: Compliance with data subject rights (Art. 18), including marking "Do Not Visit" for residents who express opposition to visits
privacy.s3UseItem1: Organizing public and pastoral visitation routes
privacy.s3UseItem2: Avoiding repetitive or unwelcome visits to residences that requested not to be contacted
privacy.s3UseItem3: Internal logistical support for the congregation
privacy.s3Note: Data is never sold, shared with third parties for marketing purposes, or economically exploited.
privacy.s4End: guidelines. The system expressly prohibits storing names of individual residents, health conditions, disabilities, or data of children and adolescents. All free-text notes are restricted to physical access characteristics of the property.
privacy.s5_1Desc: The official Campo Branco database is closed, private, and protected, accessible only to authorized users within the same congregation.
privacy.s5_2Desc: Although the {appName} software is made available as open source (MIT License), this does not apply to:
privacy.s5_3Desc: Any copy, fork, or self-hosting of the software must operate with its own independent database, having no access to the official Campo Branco database, and is the sole responsibility of whoever operates it.
privacy.s6P1: Campo Branco does not sell, rent, or share personal data with third parties for commercial purposes.
privacy.s6P2: Data access occurs exclusively internally, among authorized users of the same congregation, according to defined permissions (e.g., elders, appointed servants).
privacy.s7P1: Personal data is kept only as long as necessary for the religious and organizational purpose.
privacy.s7Item2: when the data is no longer needed
privacy.s7Item3: upon request by the data subject, when applicable
privacy.s7Note: After permanent deletion, the data no longer remains accessible to the user.
privacy.s8Lead: Campo Branco adopts appropriate technical and organizational measures, including:
privacy.s8Item4: encryption in transit and, when applicable, at rest
privacy.s8Note: Despite the best practices adopted, no system is completely immune to risks inherent to the digital environment.
privacy.s9Lead: Under the LGPD, the data subject may request:
privacy.s9Item1: confirmation of the existence of processing
privacy.s9Item3: correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data
privacy.s9Note: Requests must be made through the channels of the responsible congregation or the support indicated in the application.
privacy.s10P1: This Privacy Policy may be updated at any time. The most recent version will always be available in the application.
privacy.s10P2: Continued use of Campo Branco after any changes implies awareness and agreement with the current version.
privacy.s11P1: For questions, requests, or clarifications related to privacy and personal data protection, Campo Branco provides specific channels in compliance with the LGPD.
privacy.s11_1P1: The Data Protection Officer (DPO) is the point of contact between data subjects, Campo Branco, and the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD). Their responsibilities include:
privacy.s11_1Item1: Receiving and responding to requests from data subjects
privacy.s11_1Item2: Providing guidance on data protection best practices
privacy.s11_1Item3: Acting as a communication channel with the ANPD

about.title: What is Campo Branco
about.subtitle: The mission and purpose behind the tool.
about.introEnd: is an Open Source digital solution developed to help congregations organize, manage, and distribute territories for religious and pastoral activities.
about.purposeDesc: Simplify administrative work so volunteers can focus on what truly matters: pastoral activity and caring for people.
about.transparencyDesc: All code is open and auditable. There are no black boxes. The project is built with a focus on privacy, security, and simplicity.
about.philosophyP1Start: The name "Campo Branco" (White Field) is a reference to Jesus' words in John 4:35:
about.philosophyQuote: "Lift up your eyes and view the fields, that they are white for harvesting."
about.philosophyP2: We believe technology should serve as a discreet and efficient facilitator, always respecting the voluntary and sacred nature of the work it supports.
about.importantNoticeStart: This application is an independent and collaborative initiative. It is
about.importantNoticeEnd: an official tool of the religious organization of Jehovah's Witnesses, although it is specifically designed to be useful and compatible with their local activities.
about.homeItem2: Quick access to shared territory cards.
about.settingsDesc: Customize your app experience by adjusting themes (Light/Dark), font size, and editing your profile information.
